summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is hex-identifier obfuscated and downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` (~727KB) whose contents are heavily obfuscated with an obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array (`WV8StW` shift rotator over a mixed array). The advertised purpose is a browser-side card-fields SDK (`Types`, `FieldFrame*`, `Form`); a browser SDK has no legitimate reason to fetch a second JavaScript runtime and execute a large opaque payload on the installer's host at install time. The name `math_init.js` does not correspond to any documented functionality of the package. The alternate-runtime execution vehicle is a known technique for evading Node-focused static analyzers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
